offence_category.correct_value: Kidnapping/abduction of a minor girl, procuration of a minor, and rape
offence_category.quote: The appellant Sat Parkash has also been acquitted of the offence punishable under Section 302
offence_category.reason: Culpable homicide is not charged; the murder charge was dropped and the surviving charges are kidnapping, procuration and rape.

statutory_provisions.correct_value: IPC ss.363, 366, 366-A, 376 (s.368 charged against uncle and aunt; s.302 r/w 34 charged, appellant acquitted)
statutory_provisions.quote: The surviving charges against the appellant are relatable only to Sections 363, 366, 366-A and 376
statutory_provisions.reason: Omits s.302 r/w 34 and wrongly lists s.368 as against the appellant; surviving charges exclude s.368.

weapon.reason: The judgment states poison was administered, so 'None mentioned' contradicts the text.

evidence_type.correct_value: Suicide note (treated as dying declaration); no eyewitness evidence mentioned
evidence_type.quote: The dying declaration of Sushila indicates, that she had committed suicide
evidence_type.reason: Dying declaration is correct, but eyewitness evidence is never mentioned in the judgment.

confession.reason: No confession by the accused is recorded; the suicide note is not a confession of the offence.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: No aggravating circumstances are noted in the judgment.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: No mitigating circumstances are noted in the judgment.

trial_court_outcome.reason: Headnote records acquittal of murder and conviction under ss.363, 366, 366-A, 368, 376.

high_court_outcome.quote: High Court upheld the order of conviction
high_court_outcome.reason: Judgment states the High Court upheld the conviction, not that it was not applicable.

final_outcome.reason: Supreme Court allowed the appeal and set aside the conviction, so the appellant is acquitted.

offence_finally_established.reason: No offence was finally established; all convictions were set aside.

imprisonment_type.reason: No sentence is imposed as the conviction is set aside.

imprisonment_years.reason: No term of imprisonment is imposed in the judgment.

fine_rs.reason: No fine is imposed in the judgment.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Neutral summary of charges, the suicide note and the presumption of kidnapping, without stating the acquittal or that the girl was found dead in the residence.
neutral_facts.quote: The girl was found dead in the accused's residence.
neutral_facts.reason: Judgment does not say she was found dead there; the summary also reveals the outcome, which neutral facts must not do.

offence_severity.correct_value: Up to ten years imprisonment and fine (s.366A punishment only)

attempt_completion.reason: Judgment describes a suicide attempt, not whether the charged offences were attempted or completed.

physical_harm.quote: While in the attempt, Sushila had died
physical_harm.reason: Judgment confirms the deceased died; death caused is supported.

number_of_offences.correct_value: Five offences charged; none finally upheld (all convictions set aside)
number_of_offences.quote: the conviction of the appellant - Sat Parkash, on the charges framed ... is clearly not sustainable
number_of_offences.reason: Five charges were framed, but none remained; the court set aside all convictions, not four upheld.

financial_property_loss.reason: No financial or property loss is mentioned.

premeditation_planning.reason: No premeditation or planning of the alleged murder is stated.
